answer.original_source: Valar Atomics and Nvidia announcement on 2026-07-01, reported by Deseret News (media relay of the companies' plans)
answer.new_information: Valar Atomics and Nvidia are only considering a 30 MW, nearly waterless Utah data center using the Ward250 reactor and Nvidia water-efficient cooling. No commitment, contract value, or Nvidia revenue figure is given. The Ward250 went critical on June 18, 2026 and is generating 100 kW, a Valar self-reported status. NRC licensing is still required before commercial power. The NRC review-time goal of under 18 months is undated. No catalog or stored questions exist to update, and the record does not carry a position-level judgement.
answer.reason: The record is a pickup of an exploratory partnership with no committed size, value, or Nvidia revenue, so it moves no number or condition in any question. The 30 MW figure is a proposal, the Nvidia role is cooling technology, and the nuclear milestones are Valar self-reports. The catalog and stored pieces are empty, so there is nothing to update and no investment judgement to propose.
